title: builder.request
description: Ask the builder bot to build one SCXML machine from a natural-language specification.

context.description: Data the specification refers to, which the design and author prompts carry beside it as model-facing XML (decision D201) [floppy field].

document_max_completion_tokens.description: The author call's first token bound (default 16384); a truncated author generation doubles it for the next, up to 65536 (decision D135) [floppy field].

apply.description: The live turn a turn behavior is run on before it is built (the input of the live-turn check, decision D131): the turn, the behavior input as autonomy builds it, the sessions that turn's output names, and the turn's choices (decision D220) [floppy field].

choices.description: The live turn's choices: each selection must be an event its target takes on that turn, with data its schema admits, as the dispatch is checked (decision D220).

handled.description: Whether the run must handle the live turn (default true); false for a turn that taught the behavior, whose message is the lesson (decision D221).

decline.description: A second input of the same turn the behavior must decline (handled false with no selections): a lesson's counterexample, beside a live input that is the lesson's example (decision D228).
